feeds.title: Salt&Light Blog
feeds.description: Equipping marketplace Christians to Serve and Lead. Salt&Light is a gathering place for Christians to unite in spirit and purpose to see God in the 9-to-5, to influence and to impact, to find meaning in the mundane, to wrestle with doubt and despair in faith and find amazing grace for the journey ahead.

feeds.title: IMPACT Blog
feeds.description: IMPACT Blog is a Christian platform that addresses relevant topics and issues from a biblical perspective. Explore articles on culture, social justice, faith, and current events. IMPACT Blog aims to engage readers in thoughtful discussions and inspire them to make a positive impact in their communities.

feeds.title: City News
feeds.description: City News is a Christian news portal that covers local and international Christian news, testimonies, and practical teachings. Discover articles on faith, family, leadership, and personal growth. City News aims to inspire, inform, and connect believers through engaging content and impactful stories.

feeds.title: BLOGPASTOR
feeds.description: BLOGPASTOR is a personal blog that shares reflections, insights, and experiences from the perspective of a pastor. Explore articles on spirituality, church life, and cultural observations. BLOGPASTOR aims to offer a unique perspective on faith and ministry in Singapore.

feeds.title: Singapore Youth For Christ
feeds.description: Singapore Youth For Christ's blog focuses on ministry to young people and youth discipleship. Discover articles on youth culture, mentoring, outreach, and spiritual formation. Singapore Youth For Christ aims to inspire and equip youth leaders and young believers in their faith journey.

feeds.title: One Thing Ministries
feeds.description: One Thing Ministries' blog offers teachings, devotionals, and resources to deepen believers' intimacy with God and ignite their passion for Him. Discover articles on prayer, worship, spiritual growth, and encounters with God's presence. One Thing Ministries aims to foster a deep love for Jesus and a lifestyle of pursuing Him above all else.

feeds.title: Jurong Christian Church
feeds.description: Jurong Christian Church's blog provides insights, teachings, and updates from the church community. Discover articles on faith, missions, and practical Christian living. Jurong Christian Church aims to encourage and edify believers in their relationship with God and their involvement in the local church.

feeds.title: ETHOS Institute for Public Christianity
feeds.description: ETHOS Institute for Public Christianity's blog explores the interface between faith, culture, and society. Discover articles on ethics, social issues, and the Christian perspective on public life. ETHOS Institute for Public Christianity aims to engage Christians and the wider society in meaningful conversations on matters of faith and ethics.

feeds.title: Sacred Companion Singapore Blog
feeds.description: Sacred Companion Singapore Blog offers reflections, prayers, and meditations for spiritual nourishment and guidance. Discover articles on prayer practices, contemplative spirituality, and drawing closer to God in everyday life. Sacred Companion Singapore Blog aims to provide a space for spiritual reflection and companionship on the faith journey.

feeds.title: Singapore Christian
feeds.description: Singapore Christian is a blog that covers a range of Christian topics, including theology, apologetics, and spirituality. Discover articles on biblical teachings, church history, and reflections on Christian living. Singapore Christian aims to provide resources and perspectives that deepen believers' understanding of their faith.

feeds.title: David & Goliath Preschool Blog
feeds.description: David & Goliath Preschool (DGP) was previously known as Jurong Christian Church Kindergarten. The best kindergarten and leading nursery in Jurong was established in 1967, serving over 2 generations of students who are nurtured with love and confidence.

feeds.title: The People's Church Blog
feeds.description: The People's Church Blog provides resources, sermons, and articles that aim to deepen believers' understanding of the Bible and equip them for effective Christian living. Discover teachings on prayer, discipleship, and practical topics relevant to the Christian journey. The People's Church Blog aims to nurture and empower individuals in their spiritual growth.

feeds.title: Creation Care SG Blog
feeds.description: Creation Care SG Blog explores the intersection of faith and environmental stewardship. Discover articles on sustainable living, conservation, and the Christian call to care for the Earth. Creation Care SG Blog aims to raise awareness and inspire action for environmental sustainability among Christians in Singapore.

feeds.title: Saint George's Church Blog
feeds.description: Saint George's Church Blog shares reflections, sermons, and updates from the life of the church community. Discover articles on faith, discipleship, and engaging with the world as followers of Christ. Saint George's Church Blog aims to provide spiritual nourishment and connect readers with the church's activities and teachings.

feeds.title: Awaken Generation Blog
feeds.description: Awaken Generation Blog focuses on worship, music, and creative arts in the context of Christian faith. Discover articles on songwriting, worship leading, and the power of art to impact lives. Awaken Generation Blog aims to inspire and equip worshipers and creatives to use their talents for God's glory.

feeds.title: Christian Connection
feeds.description: Christian Connection's blog provides insights and advice on Christian dating, relationships, and faith. Discover articles on singleness, marriage, and navigating the modern dating landscape as a Christian. Christian Connection aims to support and encourage Christians in their pursuit of healthy relationships and a vibrant faith.

feeds.title: Loaves and Fishes Blog
feeds.description: CCMC (Chinese Christian Missions in Singapore) Blog focuses on missions, evangelism, and cross-cultural engagement. Explore articles on global missions, cultural diversity, and sharing the Gospel in different contexts. CCMC Blog aims to equip and inspire Christians in their mission to reach the world with the message of Christ.
